svg.title: Fig. 149(a) — Curves parallel to the ellipse
svg.desc: Redrawn from Robert C. Yates, A Handbook on Curves and Their Properties (1947), Fig. 149(a), page 157. Section: parallel.

g.data-text: The ellipse (thin) with its major axis.
At a series of points of the ellipse take the normal (the faint lines) and lay off k along it outwards (outer branch) and, with a longer k, inwards (inner branch).
Draw the two parallel curves through the points: the outer one is an oval, the inner one has four cusps, where k is the radius of curvature of the ellipse.
